label: VERIFIED
extraction: MARS (Multi-Agent Review System, Wang et al. 2025): replaces round-table debate with independent reviewers whose comments are aggregated by a meta-reviewer. Author generates candidate solution. Three independent reviewers audit it. Meta-reviewer aggregates three reviews into single decision and revision suggestions. Cycle repeats up to K rounds. MARS reduces overhead of multi-agent debate while preserving independent review. AR takes middle position between full multi-agent debate and MARS: preserves interaction but restricts communication to single channel with explicit disagreement types. Goal: evidence-grounded pushback before main agent edits/commits, not open-ended debate.
transfer_harness_fact: matches harness but specific transfer path not established
